definitions.short: properly, to bend , i.e. (figuratively) to tame or subdue
definitions.full: H3711. kaphah [ כָּפָה ] verb probably subdue (Late Hebrew overturn, hold under, compel ; Aramaic כְּפָא , id. ; incline (as face to ground), overturn ; Assyrian kipû perhaps id. , Dl HWB 346 ; compare Arabic overturn, turn back ); — only Qal Imperfect יִכְמֶּהאָֿ֑ף בַּסֵּתֶר מַתָּן Prov 21:14 a gift in secret subdueth anger (so Thes Rob-Ges; Ew beugt: Fl De averteth , from the Arabic, is more remote; ᵐ5 ἀνατρέπει, compare Late Hebrew). כִּמָּה see below כפף .
